object.attr: derived: CF-E26. A refusal clears the history (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-358), so the user must know which file to look at and where an earlier copy is. Answered on 2026-11-11 (failure Q11).
object.description: When the Document Editor refuses an undo or redo, the Document Editor shall name the file that changed and say that the file's committed copy is in git.
